fields.content: Hook layer restructured: 3 hooks removed, replaced by Sahjhan enforcement engine. enforcement/hooks/ 7 new files. Architecture baseline stale.
PAT-005 recurring: README counts stale — hooks count, test count, run count, lines of code all diverged
646 passed, 1 failed. mypy broken by duplicate _common. 8 ruff errors.
Cold ratio 54%. enforcement/hooks 6 of 7 cold. migrate_legacy cold.
Major arch shift: Sahjhan replaced 3 hooks. 7 new enforcement files. README stale.
8 predictions: 3 HIGH (enforcement, README, mypy), 3 MEDIUM (migrate, dual-impl, convergence), 2 LOW

fields.description: Gate SQL uses JSON arrow syntax (fields->>key) but Sahjhan flattens fields to columns; query fails with schema error
Gate commands reference CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT for script paths; breaks in dev mode and any non-plugin context. snapshot_compare gates also use this pattern.
README describes 3 deleted hooks (impact_graph_gate, status_staleness_gate, artifact_verification) as current features. These were replaced by Sahjhan enforcement engine.
README counts stale: 14300 lines (actual 18151), 19 runs (actual 30+), 6 enforcement hooks (actual 9 hook files). PAT-005 recurring.
Architecture baseline Module Dependencies table lists 3 deleted hooks as active modules. Structural Snapshot stale.
Coverage badge says 65% but actual coverage is 76%. Badge stale.
bash_guard protocol_violation recording uses --file_path and --detail as direct CLI args but sahjhan requires --field key=value syntax. Violation events silently fail to record.
primer.py context_reset recording uses --trigger as direct CLI arg but sahjhan requires --field trigger=value syntax. context_reset events silently fail to record, breaking awaiting_clear gate.

write_guard blocks ALL writes to docs/holtz/ but only sahjhan-rendered files should be blocked. Blocks legitimate writes to recon/, audit/, impact-graph.json, architecture-baseline.md, LIVING-PUNCHLIST.md, patterns-brief.md. Would break the entire audit workflow when hooks are active.
8 enforcement hook tests only exercise binary-not-installed early-exit path. Actual guard logic never tested. Green Bar Addict.
test_finding_rejects_invalid_id_pattern conditionally asserts — passes silently with zero assertions when sahjhan accepts invalid IDs. Green Bar Addict.
8 test classes depend on hardcoded path to one developers machine session file. Always skipped in CI. Mystery Guest + Brittle Oracle.
bash_guard protocol_violation also missing required fields (project, run, auditor). Even with fixed CLI syntax, the event would fail validation. Double bug: wrong arg format AND missing fields.
Path prefix collision: startswith check without trailing separator means docs/holtz2 or enforcement_evil would match. Fix: append os.sep before startswith.
Three enforcement hooks catch only FileNotFoundError+TimeoutExpired but PermissionError (binary not executable) is uncaught. Crashes hook process, no JSON output.
PAT-001: migrate_legacy.py applies regex to raw markdown in 3 functions without masking code fences. Field extraction, prediction parsing, and format detection all affected.
parse_summary uses greedy regex for total/resolved counts that can match wrong values. Total Resolved: 7 before Total Findings: 10 extracts 7 as total.

Dev-mode settings.local.json missing UserPromptSubmit primer hook, Stop stop_gate hook, and PreToolUse write_guard/sahjhan_bootstrap hooks. Only commit_gate and protocol_tracker registered. Primer never fires in dev mode, breaking /clear resume workflow.
Sahjhan fix_commit gate uses {{item_id}} template variable but Sahjhan does not interpolate templates in gate commands. Template passed literally to shell, always fails.
Render pipeline requires 'run' ledger but protocol uses 'default' ledger. PUNCHLIST.md and STATUS.md never rendered. Template output stale.
